responsibility: Provides the autogenerated mapping from AVR target options declared in `avr.opt` to their manual URL anchors in the generated GCC documentation. GCC’s option-documentation machinery uses this companion table to associate switches such as `-mmcu`, `-mfuse-add`, `-mfuse-move`, AVR-specific warnings, and floating-type width options with the corresponding `AVR-Options.html` entries, so the file serves documentation/link metadata rather than backend code-generation logic.
